title: Release v0.3.3 - ObjectAI documentation + critical build fixes
body:
## Overview

Version bump to 0.3.3 for new ObjectAI documentation. Required fixing multiple build-blocking issues discovered during release preparation.

## Version Updates

All packages bumped from 0.3.2 → 0.3.3 via changesets:
- Core: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/types`
- Runtime: `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/client`
- Drivers/Plugins: `@objectstack/driver-memory`, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/plugin-msw`

## Build Fixes

### Schema Definition Errors
- **validation.zod.ts**: Fixed malformed JSDoc comment block containing orphaned schema properties; added missing `CustomValidatorSchema` and `JSONValidation` type exports
- **ai/index.ts**: Corrected module export path (`orchestration.zod` not `workflow-automation.zod`)

### Module Boundary Corrections
Moved types to their correct protocol layers:
```typescript
// Before
import { DriverInterface } from '@objectstack/spec/system';
import { ApiEndpoint } from '@objectstack/spec/system';

// After  
import { DriverInterface } from '@objectstack/spec/data';
import { ApiEndpoint } from '@objectstack/spec/api';
```

### Query API Normalization
Aligned with QuerySchema specification:
- `top` → `limit`
- `skip` → `offset`  
- `filters` → `where`
- `sort` → `orderBy`

### Driver Protocol Compliance
- Added missing capability flags: `vectorSearch`, `geoSpatial`
- Removed `implements DriverInterface` (zod function schemas don't support structural typing)

## Documentation

Updated CHANGELOG.md and RELEASE_NOTES.md with v0.3.3 details.
